verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a productivity and collaboration suite, since buyers often compare cloud suites against self-hostable alternatives, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Google Workspace can be deployed on user-controlled infrastructure. The evidence covers only cloud admin APIs, SSO, device management and Apps Script automation, none of which amounts to self-hosting the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
